UserCloudProfile.title: UserCloudProfile
UserCloudProfile.description: Cloud backup of the user's personal finance profile, currency preference, and theme preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this profile.

displayName.description: User display name editable in Account > Profile.

paydayDay.description: Day of month (1-31) for payday countdown.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code selected by user (e.g. IDR, USD, EUR).

hideBalances.description: Privacy toggle to mask balance amounts on dashboard and wallets.

CloudWallet.title: CloudWallet
CloudWallet.description: User-scoped multi-wallet account supporting Tunai, Indonesian E-Wallets, and Indonesian Banks.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this wallet.

providerCode.description: Indonesian bank or e-wallet catalog code.

providerShortName.description: Short bank or e-wallet name (e.g. BRI, Bank Jago, GoPay).

providerCompanyName.description: Legal corporate entity name (e.g. PT. Bank Rakyat Indonesia).

accountNumberHint.description: Optional masked account number or phone hint.

isDefault.description: Whether this wallet is the default selection for new transactions.

CloudPocket.title: CloudPocket
CloudPocket.description: Personal money pocket / target (Kantong) supporting both budget-limit regress and savings-goal progress.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this pocket.

name.description: Target pocket name such as Makan/Minum.

targetAmount.description: Max budget or target amount in Rupiah.

currentAmount.description: Spent amount (BUDGET_LIMIT) or saved amount (SAVINGS_GOAL) in Rupiah.

iconKey.description: Icon identifier for pocket visual badge.

featured.description: Whether pocket is highlighted as featured bento card.

CloudTransaction.title: CloudTransaction
CloudTransaction.description: Income or expense record with detailed item purchase note and wallet attribution.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this transaction.

title.description: Short title for the income or expense.

note.description: Detailed note describing what was purchased or source of funds.

pocketId.description: Linked pocket ID or empty string if uncategorized.

walletId.description: Linked wallet ID or empty string.

locationName.description: Merchant or place name for expense transactions.

CloudBill.title: CloudBill
CloudBill.description: User-scoped debt (Utang) or receivable (Piutang) record with installment tracking.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this bill.

totalAmount.description: Total bill amount in base IDR.

paidAmount.description: Installment amount already paid in base IDR.

note.description: Purpose note explaining what the money was used for.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: User-scoped cloud transactions backup with detailed notes.
